title: PofBC health organization vector-logo research

summary.coverageCaveat: All 112 former-health vector gaps received individual, bounded public-source artwork searches. Promising sources were inspected when accessible. This does not establish that no logo or vector exists outside the sources searched.

rows.notes: Verified original vector logo from page 22 of the official Climate Change and Sustainability Roadmap 2023–2028. The primary SVG contains the 17 original blue logo paths plus one clip definition, with all other page content removed. Supplemental black stacked signage specimen also recovered, but it uses CAD hatching and is less suitable as a clean master.
searchQueries: Interior Health climate change sustainability roadmap 2023 2028

assets.method: isolate original vector PDF title-block logo by removing all non-logo content before cropping; embedded font outlined by MuPDF, no traced geometry
assets.dateMeaning: document/sheet dates, not logo adoption date
assets.caveat: Published CAD/signage specimen rendered as hatched vector geometry. Stronger stand-alone curve master is still preferred. The enclosing title-block rules and other page contents were removed, not merely clipped.

validation.renderComparison: Source PDF logo region visually compared to output; CAD hatching retained. Supplemental, not preferred primary asset.

assets.method: retain only the original 17-path logo group from converted PDF page 22; no tracing, redrawing or recolouring

validation.renderComparison: Whole PDF page converted by MuPDF and viewed in matching logo region matches the selected-only SVG exactly; page background lies outside the logo region.
